record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Four units declare OUTRAGE: Axew (1 star, passive HATCH), Fraxure (2 stars, passive HATCH), Druddigon and Haxorus (3 stars). The strategy is shared; the star table gives 3 for all listed star counts.
record.summary: The caster confuses itself for 2000 ms (requested; reductions and immunities apply) and deals SPECIAL damage equal to round(its current attack x 3) to the cast target and to every other unit adjacent to the caster that is on the target's team. The multiplier is 3 for 1 to 3 stars (6 at 4 or more).

targeting.who: the cast target plus units adjacent (8 neighbours) to the caster on the target's team; self for confusion
targeting.note: The target is added even if it is not adjacent; other units must be adjacent to the caster, not to the target. The filter compares to the target's team, so it matches enemies of the caster for a normal enemy target.

geometry.shape: the caster's 8 neighbour cells (filtered by team) plus the cast target

effects.scaling: no AP boost (apBoost default false); SANDSTORM weather x1.3; then Swift Swim / Hydration / Water Veil / Surge Surfer and Odd Keystone reductions via the status helper
effects.resolution: not applied if the caster is already confused, has runeProtect or IMMUNITY_CONFUSION; applied duration = rounded result. While confused the unit picks targets with getTargetWhenConfused. Confusion is applied before the damage amount is computed; attack is unaffected by confusion itself.

effects.target: the cast target and units adjacent to the caster on the target's team
effects.scaling: base is the caster's current attack at cast time; then x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: per unit: blocked (takenDamage 0) if protect / skydiving / magicBounce; otherwise handleDamage divides by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF and applies later reductions and shields; requested, applied and takenDamage can differ for each unit

statusEffects.effect: the confused caster chooses attack targets with getTargetWhenConfused; target cleared when confusion ends

starBehavior.note: The table is indexed by the casting entity's stars; listed units are 1 to 3 stars and all use 3. The 4-star entry (6) is also the fallback.

record.positionalConditions: Units other than the target are hit only if adjacent to the caster (8 neighbours) and on the target's team; the target is hit wherever it is.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Single mode. A new cast while already confused leaves the confusion cooldown unchanged (trigger is ignored) but still deals damage.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw): 3 x current attack per unit hit (listed units all use 3) and 2000 ms self confusion. Applied: damage after AP, crit, protect block, SPE_DEF division and later reductions per target; confusion only if not already confused or protected.
